reference_policy: Independent arithmetic, direct enumeration, CSV parsing and third-party Ed25519 verification; no system verdict is used as a reference answer.

criteria: exact value enclosed in every interval

pcs.criteria: Positive signed fixture ACCEPT; artifact corruption REJECT; malformed transcript nonzero exit. failed_observation remains a recorded diagnostic with the original erroneous REJECT expectation and is excluded from correctness scoring.
pcs.limitation: Existing-system positive fixture is a compatibility control, not an unfamiliar task; negative byte and transcript controls do not assess general scientific adequacy. No production/private data is used.

site.criteria: Python csv/set overlap and row multiplicities equal actual JS result; malformed CSV rejected; report states browser-only scope and no study adequacy guarantee.

interpretation: Capability-specific conformance controls only. No external biological validity claim, fresh Lean proof replay, hidden labels, LLM performance claim or cross-system leaderboard.
revision_note: After the first run, source inspection showed that the expected REJECT for a FAIL transcript was erroneous: verified builtin checkers override transcript outcomes. Preserve this as an unscored reference-error diagnostic, not a subject defect. v1 protocol/results retained; no pristine preregistration claim.
